Backing object-store/provider cache state is unknown and was not observed; this is not provider-cold.
cold_clone.verification_scope: local OID/bytes/fsck checks follow the clone timer and are excluded, exactly as for every concurrent worker

concurrent.aggregate_definition: max(clone end) - min(clone start): from the first git clone call start to the last git clone call return; local OID/content/object-format/fsck verification runs only after the window closes
concurrent.timed_scope: git clone only, for every worker and for the aggregate: the aggregate runs from the first clone start to the last clone return, and every local OID/content/object-format/fsck check runs afterwards on the main thread, outside every timed boundary
concurrent.verification_scope: per-worker verification_seconds are informational only: with a fixed worker pool later workers verify after their clone timer stops, so these are never compared or summed

fixture_retention.reason: passed run removes its owned temporary fixture; the random schema is always dropped

issue.statement: Native Blob-only baseline entry; it neither marks #106 complete nor freezes budgets.

limitations: One loopback HTTP origin, one PostgreSQL server and one configured OpenDAL S3 provider on one host; no HA, multi-host, physical durability or production-latency claim. PostgreSQL scope: Issue106 lane dedicated baseline PostgreSQL database + harness isolated random schema; requires no concurrent same-name Rootyard CLI/service on that database and no PostgreSQL pooler or shared database. A pre-start check requires zero named sessions and every sample requires the named session count to equal the service PID's endpoint socket count (nonzero), so an extra same-name session is rejected.
The restart is a SIGTERM to this harness's own serve-blob process group; kernel/power-loss behavior is not tested.
The concurrent case times 2 independent read-clone destinations from the same single seeded repository; receive-pack writes are not measured.

PostgreSQL counts are 250 ms point samples of current-database sessions named by the serve-blob sources (application_name 'rootyard'/'rootyard-blob-barrier'), cross-checked against the service PID's own ESTABLISHED sockets to the configured database endpoint: observed lower bounds only; short waits can be missed and exact lock-wait milliseconds are unmeasured. Scope: Issue106 lane dedicated baseline PostgreSQL database + harness isolated random schema; requires no concurrent same-name Rootyard CLI/service on that database and no PostgreSQL pooler or shared database. A pre-start check requires zero named sessions and every sample requires the named session count to equal the service PID's endpoint socket count (nonzero), so an extra same-name session is rejected.

The scope is a COUNT of named sessions and of PID-owned sockets (count equality per sample): it is never a per-socket four-tuple or PID-to-backend mapping, and NAT-rewritten client address/port pairs are never compared or attributed.
OpenDAL GET byte/phase metrics are unmeasured: the current service exposes no such counters to this runner.

ownership_layers.cross_check: each sample requires the named session count to be nonzero and exactly equal to the PID's ESTABLISHED endpoint socket count; client_addr/client_port are never compared with local socket address:port because NAT or a published port rewrites them; additional same-name sessions break the equality and are rejected (count only, never a per-socket four-tuple or PID mapping)
ownership_layers.process_sockets: kernel ownership: ESTABLISHED sockets of socket inodes held by the service PID (/proc/<pid>/fd) in its own /proc/<pid>/net/tcp{,6} whose remote address and DSN-configured port are the resolved database endpoint; used only to filter and count the configured database endpoint
ownership_layers.server_sessions: server identity: pg_stat_activity rows of the current test database with application_name IN ('rootyard', 'rootyard-blob-barrier'), the application pool and lifecycle barrier names set by the current Rust sources; runner and psql helper connections are not counted; scope: dedicated baseline database + harness isolated random schema, no pooler/shared database

pg_ownership_samples.procedure: two-layer ownership per sample: filter/count the service PID's own ESTABLISHED sockets to the configured database endpoint from /proc/<pid>/fd and /proc/<pid>/net/tcp{,6}, then count current-database pg_stat_activity sessions by the source-defined application_name names and require zero-free count equality, read through the isolated psql helper; before the first start (after setup migrations/accounts) and before the restart's start, the same fixed SQL must return zero named sessions
pg_ownership_samples.scope: Issue106 lane dedicated baseline PostgreSQL database + harness isolated random schema; requires no concurrent same-name Rootyard CLI/service on that database and no PostgreSQL pooler or shared database. A pre-start check requires zero named sessions and every sample requires the named session count to equal the service PID's endpoint socket count (nonzero), so an extra same-name session is rejected.
pg_ownership_samples.sql_helper: BlobOnlyHarness.sql (dedicated baseline database + isolated random schema; fixed literal PG_STAT_QUERY, no pooler, no shared database)

service_admission.explanation: smart_http reserves max_request_bytes per upload-pack body before spooling it; byte_budget_capacity = max_inflight_bytes // max_request_bytes and effective capacity = min(max_concurrent_git, byte_budget_capacity); measured concurrency must fit
service_admission.scope: configured admission only: the values are read, never overridden or widened; this is neither a measured throughput nor a frozen performance budget
service_admission.upload_pack_reservation_source: one full ROOTYARD_MAX_REQUEST_BYTES admission lease per upload-pack body before spooling (src/blob_git_gateway/smart_http.rs)

setup.scope: schema migration, fixture accounts and serve-blob start/readiness; never a measured case

unmeasured.opendal_reason: the current serve-blob process exposes no OpenDAL GET byte/phase counters to this runner
unmeasured.provider_cache_reason: no provider or service counter distinguishes cache hits; object-store cache state is unknown
